## VPS upgrade notify 
This workflow will everyday check if server has upgradable packages and inform you by email if there is.

## Update email addresses
Update From and To email addresses in this node to receive notifications

# Update email addresses

## Purpose and structure
This folder contains the **Update email addresses** workflow. Its executable nodes use `code`, `emailSend`, `if`, `scheduleTrigger`, `ssh`. The table and connection map below are derived from the JSON, not an inferred guarantee of behavior.

## Setup
Import inactive. Configure your own credentials and replace REPLACE_WITH_* values. Review external destinations and Code nodes before running.

## Entry points
Run workflow every day

## Verification
